request.system:
You extract facts from a customer's first notification of a home insurance loss.
The customer writes in Dutch or English on WhatsApp. Messages may arrive over several turns.

Rules:
- Only extract what the customer actually says. If something is not stated, return null. Never guess.
- For every value, copy the exact supporting words from the message into `quote` (verbatim, in the
  original language, no translation, no ellipsis) and give that message's id as `evidence_id`.
- Write `value` in English. Resolve relative dates ("yesterday", "last night", "Tuesday") against the
  message's sent timestamp and give dates as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `source_stopped` is true only if the customer says the cause was stopped, fixed or put out.
- `item_ages`: when the customer states how old something on the repair estimate is (or when it was
  bought), map it to that estimate line's code.
- If the customer later corrects an earlier statement, use the latest statement.
- `extraction_confidence` is your own overall confidence; it is never used for decisions.

content.text:
Customer messages:

[EV-0001] sent 2026-10-19T20:30:00+02:00:
Vanavond vloog het stopcontact in de woonkamer in brand toen de telefoon aan de lader lag. Er kwamen vlammen uit, ik heb het met een natte theedoek uitgemaakt en de groep uitgezet. De hele kamer stinkt naar rook en de muur erboven is grauw.

Repair estimate lines:
- ELEC-SOCKET-REPL: Wandcontactdoos vervangen + controle groep (age on estimate: 28.0)
- SOOT-CLEAN-ROOM: Roetreiniging woonkamer (age on estimate: not stated)
- WALL-PAINT: Wand woonkamer schilderen (age on estimate: not stated)

what_happened.value: The socket in the living room caught fire while a phone was charging; flames came out.
what_happened.quote: Vanavond vloog het stopcontact in de woonkamer in brand toen de telefoon aan de lader lag.

source.quote: het stopcontact in de woonkamer in brand toen de telefoon aan de lader lag

source_stopped.quote: ik heb het met een natte theedoek uitgemaakt

emergency_measures.value: Put out the fire with a wet tea towel and switched off the circuit group.
emergency_measures.quote: ik heb het met een natte theedoek uitgemaakt en de groep uitgezet

affected_items.label: Living room (smoke smell)
affected_items.quote: De hele kamer stinkt naar rook

parsed_output.reasoning: Loss date resolved from 'Vanavond' against the message timestamp of 2026-10-19. No time given beyond 'this evening'. No ages stated by the customer; the 28.0 on the estimate was not stated by them so it is not extracted. No police, fire brigade, theft or third party mentioned.
parsed_output.summary: Customer reports that a living room socket caught fire this evening while a phone was charging, put it out with a wet tea towel and switched off the circuit, leaving smoke and soot damage to the room and wall.
